title: 7 Best Small Jewelry Safes With Drawers in 2026

products.name: Liberty Safe - Velvet Jewelry Drawer Organizer for Gun Safes - Fits 48 Model Safes or larger and safes that are 42" or wider (15 inch)
specs: VELVET LINED: Keep your valuables scratch-free, and looking new with the velvet lined drawer.
ORGANIZATION: With several small cubbies and a ring holder, it is easy to stay organized.
COMPARTMENTALIZE: These jewelry drawers include individual compartments for necklaces, bracelets and watches as well as built in places for rings and earrings.
SEVERAL SIZES TO CHOOSE FROM: From 6.5" to 15" wide, there is a drawer to fit all your valuables.
INSTALLATION: Velvet lined jewelry drawers can be installed under the top or side adjustable shelves of safes.

products.name: Biometric Safe Jewelry Safes for Home featuring a Quick-Access Fingerprint Lock, Digital Keypad and Secure Slide-Away Drawer 14" × 16.5"
specs: Premium Multi-Layer Protection: This home jewelry safe integrates a digital keypad, biometric fingerprint lock, and backup keys for triple-layer security. Its high-strength alloy lock core and steel-reinforced leather-wrapped structure offer enhanced durability, while the slide-away drawer allows quick access to valuables such as watches, rings, or pistols—making it ideal as both a watch safe and a handgun safe

Spacious & Customizable Interior: Measuring 13.85"×13.2"×16.53", this home safe includes removable jewelry trays to organize necklaces, bracelets, and other small items. The dividers can be taken out to convert it into a firearm storage unit. With a simple press of the button on the desired drawer level, it opens instantly for easy retrieval.Batteries are not included and must be purchased separately

Smart Alarm & Vibration Alert: Once the vibration sensor is activated, this safe will sound an alarm after five consecutive incorrect password or fingerprint attempts. The system then temporarily locks and requires a correct fingerprint to reset. Features adjustable volume and a silent mode, making it suitable for both home and office environments

Advanced Tech for Convenience: This jewelry safe comes with USB charging, and an externally accessible battery compartment (tools required) to ensure continuous operation. The built-in digital display shows the time and also serves as an elegant decorative element, perfect for placement in bedrooms, closets, or offices

Elegant & Multi-Scenario Use: Designed with a refined leather exterior, this safe blends effortlessly into living rooms, wardrobes, or bedside settings. Its anti-theft alarm and flexible storage options—for either jewelry or firearms—make this home safe an essential addition for security-focused households
